# Lemontart agent pack

Drop this folder on an agent that can read files. It is the skills plus the markdown docs those skills are allowed to treat as this config. It is not the LinuxCNC tree. INI, HAL, NGC, and the vendor PDFs under `docs/reference/` stay in the config repo.

## What you give the agent

The whole `lemontart-agent` directory. Point it at `skills/lemontart-mill/SKILL.md` first. A pasted following-error plot starts at `skills/lemontart-servo-tuning/SKILL.md`.

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `skills/lemontart-mill/SKILL.md` | Setup, diagnosis, Probe Basic, tool change, servo swap. Source rank and the “not in the allowed sources” rule. |
| `skills/lemontart-servo-tuning/SKILL.md` | One gain suggestion from a plot. Does not write the drive. |
| `docs/` | Copies of the config repo’s guides, at the version in `VERSION`. |

An agent that only receives a chat paste and cannot open `docs/` has to say so and stop. The skills forbid guessing pin names and object indexes.

## Rebuild

From the config repo:

```bash
python3 scripts/build_agent_release.py
python3 scripts/build_agent_release.py --check
```

The script copies `agent/VERSION`, `agent/README.md`, both skills, every `docs/*.md`, and `docs/assets/`. It does not copy `docs/reference/` (vendor PDF and spreadsheet). Edit the skills under `agent/`, edit the guides under `docs/`, then rebuild. Do not hand-edit `release/lemontart-agent/`.

Ship `release/lemontart-agent/` as the release folder. The version string is `agent/VERSION`.
